title: Speaker Framing
description: Framing decisions for talking-head video. Joins a pose/face detector's per-frame person lists (text lane) with the frame grabber's frame table (table lane) and the caller's JSON (text lane, a `framing` block carrying the run's settings). In `plan` mode it tracks people across frames, estimates who is talking from head motion gated by word timings, plans dwell-limited layouts (solo follow, two-person stacked, side by side, screen share, full frame, fixed crop, original) with smoothed face-safe crop paths, scores the result (speaker visible %, layout changes, pan speed, face-safe checks) and merges the plan into the incoming JSON under `framing_plan` for a renderer downstream. In `scan` mode it clusters the sparse samples into the people on screen (position, size, presence timeline, a thumbnail each) and detects shot changes. Every path is caller-supplied: `write_to` (layout.json, or people.json + scenes.json), `thumbnails_to`, `status_to`.
